review_order: All original frozen groups, ascending canonical source and group_id; whole original units in bounded reading packets, no rank shortlist or success selection.
prior_exposure: Implementation, metric concepts, source families and failed annotations were already seen. Existing56partial external-model jobs are rejected, not independent holdout annotations. No new census retrieval ranking has run.

source_rating_rule.0: Irrelevant, administrative, bibliographic or an isolated incomplete fragment with no usable contribution.
source_rating_rule.1: Same-topic background, a finding without the needed method, or a different quantity/estimand that cannot provide the claimed task component.
source_rating_rule.2: Substantive applicable interpretation/scope restriction for an actual task quantity or method; not mere uncertainty-by-analogy.
source_rating_rule.3: Explicit definition/procedure/mathematical method providing an actual task component, with its assumptions. Not whole-product validation.

positive_proof: Every2/3pair links a source-only proposition, its actual quantity and exact verbatim original quote to a bounded task relation and nontransferable claims. Task conditions cannot be attributed to source.
quantity_policy: No HR/EE sensor-error transfer to logged repetitions/RIR, no baselineTEE=restingenergy, no precision=structuralidentifiability, no false personal/causal/prescriptive authority. Qualitative family scope can constrain a genuine member without transferring protocol-specific numerical accuracy.
ambiguity_policy: Record unresolved scientific relevance explicitly and resolve before freezing; do not force an adjacent grade merely to match an earlier synthetic expectation.
complete_matrix_rule: Each full unit must be read and have an explicit reviewed record for all29tasks. Sparse omitted grades become0 only in that reviewed record; missing units never become0.
claim_review_rule: Read all61currentclaim statements/scopes and complete originals without production metric bindings; separately record entailment, task relevance and exact factual support. Then select minimal condition-matching required claims with bounded scope/refusal.
pre_freeze_gate: All1675sourceunits and61claim packets reviewed, complete exact quotations, no unresolved relevance, source/claim consistency, direct real-source semantic checks, original input protection; not synthetic-control success alone.
known_counterexample_scope: Previously observed failures are development checks; do not count them as new independent cases.
